_comment: APPAREL ONLY. Every topic must target apparel and fashion brands and the brand-world / campaign layer (campaigns, lookbooks, editorial, lifestyle, identity) — never fit/PDP/catalog photography, and never beauty, supplements, food, beverage, home, pet, tech, CPG, or geo content. The studio is '100 — a brand-world studio for apparel.' Positioning: the campaign, not the catalog. When the queue exhausts, extend ONLY with new apparel/fashion campaign-layer briefs. Engine reads MEMORY.md first to skip recently-used angles.

_schema.angle: The sharp narrative angle — what this article SAYS
_schema.primary_keyword: Exact phrase the apparel founder would type
suggested_internal_links: specific apparel .html files to link to

topics.h1: Fashion Brand Campaign Photography for Emerging Labels
topics.angle: The campaign is what people remember before they read a word. For a young label, the first real campaign is the moment the brand stops looking like a Shopify store and starts looking like a brand. Here's how to build a campaign world without a six-figure shoot.
The lookbook has to ship the day the drop does — styled, art-directed, and on-brand, not a rushed afterthought. How to produce a full seasonal lookbook at the pace of the drop calendar.

topics.h1: Editorial Campaign Imagery for Streetwear Brands
topics.angle: Streetwear lives or dies on cultural credibility and drop urgency. The campaign has to feel like the culture, not an ad. How to build editorial campaign imagery that reads as authentic to a streetwear audience.

Activewear campaigns need motion, performance cues, and aspirational body language without sliding into stock-photo cliche. How to make activewear campaign imagery that feels like a brand, not a catalog.
Denim is texture, wash, and attitude. A denim campaign has to render authentic wash and whiskering while telling a brand story. How to build a denim brand's campaign world.

topics.h1: Swimwear Campaign Photography Without a Location Shoot
topics.angle: Swimwear campaigns traditionally mean a destination shoot and the budget that comes with it. How to build a swimwear campaign world — beach, light, mood — without booking the flights.
Knitwear sells on hand-feel and texture you can almost touch through the screen. How to art-direct a knitwear lookbook that makes the fabric the hero.

topics.h1: Building a Luxury Apparel Brand World
topics.angle: Quiet luxury is a visual language — negative space, restraint, fabric, light. How to build campaign imagery for a luxury apparel label that signals the price point without saying a word.

topics.h1: Wholesale Lookbook and Linesheet Imagery for Apparel
topics.angle: Before a retailer writes the order, they see the linesheet and the lookbook. How to make wholesale-facing apparel imagery that lands the buyer meeting.

topics.h1: Apparel Brand Identity and Campaign System
topics.angle: A campaign without an identity is just nice pictures. How to build the identity layer — voice, type, art direction — that makes every apparel campaign feel like the same brand.
In-context, real-world imagery is what makes a feed feel like a world. How to build apparel lifestyle imagery that earns the save, not the scroll.

topics.h1: Apparel Rebrand: Relaunching the Brand World
topics.angle: A rebrand is only real once the campaign ships. How to relaunch an apparel brand's entire visual world — campaign, lookbook, lifestyle — in one coordinated drop.
